# Site fixtures

`events.json`: a synthetic `data/events.json` for the website tests and the
*Site check* workflow (Lighthouse). 103 entries on Saturday 2026-11-14: 100
events in random places, times and tags (8 of them multi-day with opening
hours), one cancelled, one postponed, one unconfirmed, and three program items
of "Basteln für Kinder #1". Titles carry a number so they are unique. The data
is invented and only exercises the layout.
